name: lifecycle
notes: 016 T023 (lane V). SC-006 arms per test-pyramid.md par.3:
(1) background/resume mid-replay — the game's OWN frame-loop clamp
dt = min(0.1, wallDelta) (web/app/main.js frame(); research R10: the
shell VERIFIES, implements nothing) is asserted two ways: (a) a rAF
gap probe proves the page actually suspended (max gap >= 1.5 s) and
records dtApplied = min(0.1, gap) for the run record; (b) the no-time-
jump law — because catch-up is clamped, playback wall time must grow
by the background dwell (wall >= duration + dwell - 0.5 s). A resume
that fast-forwarded the clock would finish EARLY and fail (b).
(2) kill-recovery — relaunch with -OBInjectFailure killOnce (ONE
simulated content-process death after first readiness; 2026-07-11
recorded fix from the T034 acceptance run — contentKill re-kills
after EVERY load, so the frozen L4 'recovered' expectation (auto-
reload succeeded, NO recovery surface) was unreachable by design;
the x3 escalation path stays covered by L2 ComponentTree): the
shell's LifecycleMachine auto-reloads (<= 2 attempts, shell-app.md
par.5) and the page must be interactive again within the SC-006 5 s
budget, WITH settings intact. Settings continuity rides the R7
restore-if-absent law: phase 1 sets language 'de' and BACKGROUNDS
(snapshotSettings effect -> UserDefaults); phase 2 boots a FRESH
ephemeral store (localStorage empty), so 'de' surviving proves the
at-document-start restore script AND its survival across the
content-process kill reload.
The 5 s bound is encoded as the bounded waitEval budget below (34
tries x ~150 ms poll); eval-channel round-trip overhead makes it
slightly generous — e2e-ios.mjs additionally stamps phase wall times
in its output for the delivery record.
Checkpoints pre-background/post-resume/recovered are the L4
background-resume flow rendezvous (acceptance.mjs); e2e-ios auto-acks.
SEQUENCING (016 L3 round 1, run-15 evidence): the FIRST simctl io
screenshot on a fresh simulator takes ~44 s, so a cold capture at the
pre-background checkpoint outlives the ~7.7 s replay and the app is
back in AIM before Home is ever pressed — the screenshot-warm
checkpoint pays that cold cost BEFORE the shot (its PNG carries no L4
expectation), and the still-mid-replay assert runs BEFORE the
post-resume checkpoint so its budget is dwell + activate only.
SUSPENSION (016 L3 round 2, run 29147309968): the hosted simulator
does not reliably suspend the page on Home (max rAF gap 1378 ms over
a 3 s dwell) — the background step now VERIFIES the >= 1.5 s gap and
retries the whole cycle (<= 3), and the mid-replay assert carries the
law as a wall bound (no fast-forward = the replay cannot finish before
duration + suspended time) instead of a raw state check that reds
whenever XCUITest orchestration outlives the replay.
